plans.name: Starter
plans.tagline: One voice agent answering your website around the clock
features: Live lead capture and BANT qualification into your CRM
Consultation requests recorded on each lead

plans.name: Pro
plans.tagline: Voice qualification plus the content pipeline and CRM tooling
features: 3 configurable agent personas (e.g. inbound SDR, churn rescue)
Content pipeline: conversations into X, LinkedIn and Substack drafts
Publishes live once you connect your accounts
Encrypted storage for your platform credentials
Obsidian vault export of leads and dossiers

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.tagline: For agencies running voice for several brands
features: Separate credentials and vault exports per client brand
Enforced discount ceilings on retention offers
